page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Above it: page number at top left, running head centred. Below the last line, at the right: catchword. No margin notes, no notes under the text.

main_text.p: consignationem & contestationem, quòd Deus præparavit ab æterno hanc mensam nobis, in qua agnus ille immaculatus, ab initio mundi immolatus, & in ara crucis demum tostus, proponitur comedendus, & sanguis eius bibendus, quo nimirum animi nostri esurientes sitientesq; iustitiam refocillentur ac satientur. Hæc igi-tur meditantes interim dum ad mē-sam Domini adstamus, veneratione debita panè & vinum, haud amplius vulgari in pretio, ut res profanas, ha-bemus, sed ut sancto usui destinata mandato Domini usurpamus, & vir-tute huius cibi ac potus, quàm diu in deserto huius mundi & in via sumus, nosmet corroboramus, donec vene-rimus ad montem Domini, ubi vide-bimus eum non amplius per speculũ in ænigmate, ut nunc, sed facie ad fa-ciem sicuti est. Ubi hunc portum sa-lutis nostræ attigerimus, nihil erit quod insuper desideremus.

page.notes: Page number printed as "§4", the numeral possibly a stylised 5; read as 54 from the page sequence. Catchword "DIA-" at lower right. The faint marks at the right edge are show-through from the facing page and were left out. Spelling is normalised as the rules require (long s, u/v, i/j), so "fancto", "vfui", "defideremus" appear as sancto, usui, desideremus.
